items.quote: the union of the two events which is denoted by the symbol A ∪ B
items.claim: If A and B are two events from the sample space S, the union of the two events, denoted $A\cup B$, means the occurrence of the two events A or B or both, i.e. occurrence of at least one event.

items.quote: 9 identical cards numbered from 1 to 9 a card was drawn
items.stem: 9 identical cards numbered from 1 to 9, a card was drawn randomly. First: Write down the sample space. Second: Write down the following events: A: Getting a card with an even number. B: Getting a card with a number divisible by 3. C: Getting a card with a prime number greater than by 5. Third: use the venn diagram to calculate the probability of: a) Occurrence of A or B; b) Occurrence of A or C; c) Find $P(A)+P(B)-P(A\cap B)$, $P(A\cup B)$, what do you notice?
solution: Third a: Occurrence of A or B means $A\cup B$, where $A\cup B=\{2,3,4,6,8,9\}$, $n(A\cup B)=6$
probability of the occurrence of A or B $=P(A\cup B)=\frac{n(A\cup B)}{n(S)}=\frac{6}{9}=\frac{2}{3}$
Third b: Occurrence of A or C means $A\cup C$, they are two distant sets, then $A\cup C=\{2,4,6,7,8\}$, $n(A\cup C)=5$
probability of the occurrence of A or C $=P(A\cup C)=\frac{n(A\cup C)}{n(S)}=\frac{5}{9}$
from (1) and (2) we get $P(A)+P(B)-P(A\cap B)=P(A\cup B)$
items.notes: Stem wording 'prime number greater than by 5' and 'distant sets' printed as is. Picture of 9 green cards at top right is unnumbered, treated as decorative.

items.quote: Notic that A and B are mutually exclusive events.
items.text: Notic that A and B are mutually exclusive events. Then P(A ∪ B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A ∩ B) but (A ∩ B) = zero. ∴ P(A ∪ B) = 4/9 + 1/9 - zero = 5/9 As previously found

learning_objectives.label: Sample space and probability
learning_objectives.description: Write the sample space and events of a random experiment as sets and calculate the probability P(A) = n(A)/n(S).

learning_objectives.label: Intersection and mutually exclusive
learning_objectives.description: Determine the intersection A ∩ B of two events using a Venn diagram, calculate its probability, and identify mutually exclusive events.

learning_objectives.label: Union of events
learning_objectives.description: Determine the union A ∪ B of two events and calculate its probability using P(A ∪ B) = P(A) + P(B) − P(A ∩ B), including for mutually exclusive events.
